programme.desc: S3 E15 — Calls of the WildWhen Ginger and the Pea-Rexes notice all the animals being pranked in the valley, they follow a series of clues to try to discover the culprit.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: S1 — The Octonauts and the Fire AntsTweak, Paani, and Dashi work with a colony of fire ants to engineer an escape route when heavy downpours in Brazil cause a river to flood the ants' home.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S3 — The Tale of the Tunnel RumblerWhen Peter and his friends mistake the echoey 'rebbits' of a lost Jeremy Fisher for a scary monster, they set about to rid their tunnels of this mysterious invader. But with Tommy Brock on the warpath nearby, it won't be easy!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E2 — The Whistling BadgeWhen Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E3 — The Shape BadgeIt is a lovely day and the Squirrels are outside playing the shape game. Working out which shape goes where is quite tricky.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E5 — Jud the DentistThe class has a visit from Karen, the dental nurse, who shows them how to keep their teeth clean. She asks Jud to be a pretend dentist and give Oliver's teeth a check-over, but how many teeth does he have? Jud, Oliver and Jessica are then given the chance to practise their brushing skills with Karen. She gives them some top tips to make sure they always have gleaming white smiles. Solomon is in the dental surgery role play area.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S4 E29 — The Prickly Pear KidEvil Pea sends a load of Mini Peas to over-run and take over Tato Tower. There's only one person who can help him - the expert pea-yodeller, Prickly Pear.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E25 — Mission BubblesThe girls create a giant bubble for an aerial ballet, but Weasy, obsessed with bubbles, bursts them all before the game ends. Exasperated, the cans decide to teach him a well-deserved lesson.

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Handy DadWhen Wizz's dad arrives to fix some things at his house, things start to get out of control, and Wizz wants you to switch off before his dad ruins the house.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E12 — Sheep DogDad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E34 — Swim SchoolMum, Dad and Bingo must complete both their classes to pass swim school but pleasing strict Big Fish instructor Margaret, aka Bluey, is proving very difficult.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Zog's Crash LandingZog is too scared to fly after a bad crash landing, so Boom helps the doctors as their ambulance. Zog must overcome his fear and get back to the team.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: S2 — Woofer's BackpackWoofer has come to school without his backpack because the strap is broken.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Waffle and the Marching BandWhen a smelly, dirty Waffle runs away at the mention of baths, everyone must find and clean him in time for him to lead a marching band sing along for their head teacher, Mr Nolan.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Blueberry Jam WishRafi and Jake are making doughnuts. It goes well until Rafi wishes they had more jam.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S3 E18 — Summer: It's Time to Play Beach CricketJoJo and her family are ready for an exciting day on the beach playing cricket, but Auntie Dee hasn't packed the wickets. Luckily, Gran Gran has a plan to use things on the beach to make new wickets. Eventually, everyone has so much fun playing.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S3 E24 — Mars as MoonMars tries to fill in for a missing moon, but needs a little coaching from Sarah and Duck.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S2 E18 — The Memory BoxWhile fishing in the music boat, Tiny and Small catch a strange box. It turns out to be the memory box Mother made when she was a little girl. And this gives them an idea.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Jumpy PlanetBaBa wants to jump, like MeMo. Together they find a fun way to help BaBa bounce.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S2 E44 — Upsy Daisy Dances With the HaahoosUpsy Daisy is having a Dancy Day in the garden. First she dances with the Haahoos, then she dances with the ball, and then with the daisies in the garden.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2025 — New and Trending:05/12/2025A different story read each night just before bedtime.

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Building of Britain
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Building the CanalsFred Dibnah takes his series on the building of Britain to his home turf, Lancashire, so he can wax lyrical over the roots of the nation's canal network. He visits Worsley to see where it all began and, in his own back garden, demonstrates the early canal-building process. Fred then takes a trip on the Leeds-Liverpool waterway, revealing the hard work and skill that made such a passage possible.

programme.title: The Lakes with Paul Rose
programme.desc: S1 E1 — WindermereExplorer Paul Rose digs out his rucksack and heads for Windermere. The National Park attracts 18 million visitors each year, and is now a World Heritage Site. Paul joins the crowds and finds out why the early tourists thought the Lakes was one of the most dangerous spots in the country. He also plunges into the world of long-distance swimming and helps the staff who run the boats on the lake.

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: S2 E1 — The New Farm ManagerRichard offers Ned's services to Audrey in Brabinger's absence, but Ned thinks it is all a plot to remove him from his tied cottage so that the new farm manager can move in. Audrey decides to take her revenge.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: S4 E6 — Please Mind Your HeadWhen Hyacinth and the long-suffering Richard spend their first day in their new weekend residence, it proves to be less than adequate. Hyacinth invites Elizabeth and Emmet round for country tea, but both this and her plans to fit in with the local way of life go terribly wrong.

programme.title: The Boleyns: A Scandalous Family
programme.desc: S1 E1 — AmbitionThomas Boleyn, the patriarch of the Boleyns, is determined to elevate the family name. His ambitions for his three children will take them to the heart of the Tudor court.

programme.title: The Beginning and End of the Universe
programme.desc: S1 E1 — The BeginningProfessor Jim Al-Khalili goes back in time to tackle the greatest question in science: how did the universe begin? Uncovering the origins of the universe is regarded as humankind's greatest intellectual achievement. By recreating key experiments Jim unravels the cosmic mystery of science's creation story before witnessing a moment, one millionth of a second, after the universe sprang into existence.

programme.title: Japan's Master of Restoration
programme.desc: S1 E2 — The Four LegsThe father and son undertake the restoration of a ceramic horse from the Edo period. A previous restoration is now showing signs of age, and a new approach is needed to give the horse back its stallion stance.

programme.title: The Sky at Night
programme.desc: The UK Space RaceThe team investigates the science and engineering helping the UK blast into space. While Chris visits a rocket company near Glasgow, Maggie is given a preview of Britain's National Satellite Testing Facility.

programme.title: Sound Waves: The Symphony of Physics
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Making SoundHelen begins by exploring the simplest of ideas: what is a sound? At the Palace of Westminster, Helen teams up with scientists from the University of Leicester to investigate how Big Ben's distinctive sound is created.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: S2 E2 — GooseberryLive from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Gooseberry singing a song about everything needed to become a Gooseberry Club member.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E26 — StorytimeBing wants Flop to read him his favourite book as he has his bath, but Bing joins in with the story too enthusiastically. Flop suggests they finish the story in bed as books don't like baths. When the book falls into the bath, Bing is heartbroken, but Flop helps him to understand that even though the book is wet the story isn't.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E34 — Day TripThe Teletubbies go on a day trip to the Hidey Hup. They take turns on the Tubby Bouncy, the Tubby Slidey and the Tubby Spinny, before they go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: S2 E19 — WormTee and his friends find a worm and build it a house to live in, but it might not be the perfect home for a worm.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: S1 E19 — Shades of the ForestGreen is surprised when Black and White arrive in her forest. Learn about light and dark colours with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Muffin UnboxingStripe films Muffin unboxing a dump truck toy, but Muffin struggles to stay focused.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E8 — PJ PartyBing and Nicky are sleeping over at Sula's house, but Bing has forgotten Hoppity. The wind causes a branch to make a scratchy noise that terrifies Bing, who isn't very comforted by Sula's fairy rhino. Amma phones Flop, while Sula, Nicky and Bing play 'Nicky tickles' as they wait. Flop arrives, bringing his sleeping bag and Hoppity so they can all sleep over.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E28 — Swoppiton Speed ScrambleMojo and Bo enter the grand cross-town race, determined to win. However, their progress is hindered as they repeatedly pause to assist fellow racers in distress. How can they maintain their lead whilst being so altruistic?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E46 — The Playing BadgeThe squirrels are playing in the clubhouse. Naughty Monkey arrives and causes chaos. He later returns to his home to relax when there is a knock at his door. His cousins have come to visit.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E47 — The Party BadgeDing-dong, there is somebody at the door. It is delivery Chipmunk with a parcel for Duggee, but why is it wrapped up like a present? Maybe it is Duggee's birthday.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E13 — HouseworkMum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E34 — Swim SchoolMum, Dad and Bingo must complete both their classes to pass swim school but pleasing strict Big Fish instructor Margaret, aka Bluey, is proving very difficult.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S2 E49 — Go Jet Academy: Global GameshowIt's the Go Jetters as you've never seen them before as they take part in a disco-dazzling around the world game show! Foz and Xui are on Team Go Jetter and Grandmaster Glitch and Kyan are on Team Glitch as they go head to head to see who will win. Ubercorn and Lars are the quizmasters asking the questions in this ultimate geographic quiz.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: The Tale of the Journal's EndWhen Flopsy and Mopsy borrow Peter's journal, Peter has to save them from Old Brown, but will he lose his precious journal in the process?

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S1 E22 — The Hermit CrabWhen Captain Barnacles and most of the crew are unable to return to base, it's up to Peso and Tweak to remove a stuck Hermit Crab from its shell.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S6 E2 — Leap BlobThe Numberblocks and Numberblobs have to do some clever counting to cross a sticky swamp and reach the perfect place for a picnic.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: S1 E8 — The Breakfast BearsThe Three Bears are making a mess of their breakfast. Can the Wonderblocks help?

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Paint a Picture DayAfter Love Monster volunteers Monster Teddy to pose for everyone's paintings, he realises he misses him when they are apart. Things get even worse when Bad Idea Puppy moves Monster Teddy further away to stop him getting splashed with paint.

programme.title: Justin's House
programme.desc: S3 E10 — Pirate DayJustin, Robert and Little Monster try to protect Gem's jewels from naughty Captain Sinker when the stars of Swashbuckle drop in for Pirate Day. Guest starring Gemma Hunt and Ella Kenion.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Musical StatuesBing is at Amma's crèche, and it is his turn to choose the game, Musical Statues. Flop gets the Bingpad going and soon all the children are dancing like crazy. Sula goes out first, quickly followed by Coco who both watch for wobblers with Amma. In the final round, Bing wobbles at the last moment and Pando wins much to Bing's distress - he chose the game so he thought he should win it. Fortunately, Charlie never stopped dancing.

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: S7 E23 — wDee encourages a friend to say 'w' and goes on an adventure involving water, a worm and some wigs. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds.

programme.title: Maddie and Triggs
programme.desc: S1 E1 — BubblesIt's bath time, and Maddie and Triggs embark on a bubble-tastic submarine adventure to the bottom of the ocean in search of Triggs' favourite bath toy, Denis the Ducky.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E43 — YurticopterFiona wants to go on an adventure but can't carry all her things. The Piggies turn her yurt into a flying Yurticopter so that she can take everything with her - but is it strong enough?

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: S1 E5 — ConnectingThe Twirlywoos watch a boy tie his shoelace at a bus stop and get the idea to connect his shoelaces to the shoes of the other passengers. When the bus arrives they all stand up, only to fall in a heap.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S13 E23 — We're All Friends: Summer PartyJustin and his friends host a summer party and pick vegetables to make a delicious salad. Mr Tumble's also hosting a party, but he struggles to find a garden game that he's good at.

Megalodon is determined to get a transfer to Mobeen's wing so he can confront him about meddling in his business. Mobeen and Nate also have to deal with prison officer Saj, who's a constant thorn in their side.

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen
programme.desc: S4 E2 — It's Not What You Know..Mobeen has landed himself in the prison infirmary, where he also has a mission, to befriend a man known as 'Memory Stick' and convince him to hand over vital information. In the infirmary, he also encounters a doctor, Nida, and there's an instant spark between her and Mobeen. Nida also suggests she can help Aqsa with a placement for her medical degree, which she is thrilled with. Aqsa also receives some characteristically unhelpful advice from prison chaplain Uncle Shady.

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen
programme.desc: S4 E3 — For the Many, Not the Few..Megalodon is now on Mobeen's wing, and Mobeen must avoid him at all costs, which means trying not to leave his cell. Harper instantly makes Mobeen leave the cell to go and see Dr Nida. Nida now has Aqsa working alongside her.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: A secret agent is murdered, leaving his veteran CIA partner to transform the dead man's streetwise twin from an uncouth hustler into a credible replacement for his brother, so the agency can continue its investigation into a diabolical terrorist plot involving a nuclear bomb. Comedy thriller, starring Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Peter Stormare, Gabriel Macht and John Slattery.

programme.title: Confessions of a Shopaholic
programme.desc: Aspiring fashion journalist Rebecca Bloomwood accepts a position writing for a financial magazine. As she sets the publishing world alight with her unique brand of consumer advice, Rebecca is forced to confront her own purchasing habits and begins to question whether rampant spending sprees are the way to true happiness. Comedy, starring Isla Fisher, Hugh Dancy, Krysten Ritter and Joan Cusack.

programme.title: Forky Asks A Question
programme.desc: What Is Money?Hamm attempts to give Forky a lesson on how the US monetary system works.

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Through the steadfast support of her older sister and supportive trainers, Trudy Ederle overcomes adversity to rise through the ranks of the Olympic swimming team. She then attempts to become the first woman to successfully swim the English Channel. Drama, starring Daisy Ridley and Stephen Graham.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: A downtrodden handyman is forced to look after his niece and nephew. He soon wins them over with his knack for telling exciting stories, but to their surprise the tall tales start coming true - and as the children make their own suggestions, the results become even more incredible. Fantasy comedy, starring Adam Sandler, Keri Russell, Guy Pearce and Russell Brand.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A fairy falls in love with an ambitious human nobleman, who betrays her in pursuit of claiming the throne. She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

programme.title: The Lion King
programme.desc: After the murder of his father Mufasa, young lion prince Simba flees his African kingdom, only to learn the true meaning of responsibility and bravery as he clashes with his wicked uncle Scar. Director Jon Favreau's animated remake of Disney's 1994 blockbuster, featuring the voices of Donald Glover, Beyonce Knowles and Seth Rogen.

programme.title: Cool Runnings
programme.desc: A sprinter fails to qualify for the Jamaican Olympic squad, but refuses to give up his dream. Learning that a former US bobsleigh coach is living nearby, he seizes the chance to shine in an entirely different sport, and cajoles three of his friends to join him in training for the 1988 Winter Olympics in the far less tropical environment of Canada. Fact-based comedy, with John Candy, Leon, Doug E Doug and Malik Yoba.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Starship Troopers
programme.desc: Courageous military recruits hurl themselves into a desperate war against alien insects set on destroying mankind. They blast off for the creatures' home planet in a last-ditch attempt to save the human race from annihilation - little realising the carnage that awaits them. Sci-fi adventure from director Paul Verhoeven, starring Casper Van Dien, Denise Richards and Dina Meyer.

programme.title: The Omen
programme.desc: A US ambassador who adopted his son in suspicious circumstances is troubled by the child's increasingly disturbing behaviour. A priest contacts him and claims the boy is the offspring of the Devil, but the father refuses to believe it - until a spate of deaths convinces him otherwise. Remake of the 1976 horror classic, starring Liev Schreiber, Julia Stiles, Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick and Pete Postlethwaite.

programme.title: Flightplan
programme.desc: A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. When she wakes up, the girl has disappeared - and the mother's fear turns to outright panic when the aircraft crew insists she boarded the flight alone, suggesting the child is merely a figment of her distressed imagination. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

programme.title: George of the Jungle
programme.desc: An American heiress on holiday in Africa gets stranded in the wilderness, but is rescued by a primitive man who was raised by apes. When her cruel fiancee takes her back to the States, the besotted king of the jungle follows, but is unprepared for modern living. Comedy based on the TV cartoon series, starring Brendan Fraser, Leslie Mann, Thomas Haden Church and Richard Roundtree.

Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.

programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.desc: The son of a lion kept in a zoo in Central Park is crated up and shipped to Africa. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Kiefer Sutherland, James Belushi, Eddie Izzard, Janeane Garofalo and William Shatner.

programme.desc: Following his success with North by Northwest, director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel Psycho. Even with His wifes support, Alma Reville, the production strains the couples marriage. Fact-based drama, starring Anthony Hopkins, Helen Mirren and Scarlett Johansson.

programme.title: Lost Ships of WW2
programme.desc: The crew of a research vessel use advanced underwater cameras to locate the remains of the most famous sunken vessels of the Second World War. Just weeks before the war ended, the USS Indianapolis violently sank, and 900 sailors were stranded at sea with no rescue in sight. For five days, they fought off exposure and shark attacks in the worst disaster at sea in US naval history

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The loss of Adam Air Flight 574, which disappeared from radar screens in 2007 and crashed into the Java Sea, off Indonesia, killing 102 people on board

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: Florida law enforcement races to stop marine drug traffickers, with one high-stakes operation intercepting a boat carrying 10 pounds of marijuana

programme.title: Alaska: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Johnny Rolfe explores uncharted territory, only to find himself ensnared in unexpected circumstances. Meanwhile, Kaleb uses bush ingenuity to save a relic

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Roman spells, stone-carved cures and fossil relics blur medicine and magic

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: HSI seizes cocaine-filled tyre rims in Puerto Rico and a load of meth and fentanyl in San Diego. CBP Miami intercepts $400,000 of cash bound for Cuba

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: A look at how Argentine sauce and a speedy pad Thai are made in factories

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: A glimpse behind the scenes at the manufacturing of DIY pizza and fresh orange juice

programme.title: Exotic Animal ER: Double Dose
programme.desc: Dr K treats a cockatiel's potentially fatal inflamed sinuses. An Arctic fox won't eat or drink, raising suspicions of poisoning. An anaemic box turtle has a possible prolapse

programme.title: Exotic Animal ER: Double Dose
programme.desc: A pregnant pine snake has to have her eggs surgically removed when she cannot lay naturally. A chameleon has a swollen eye, and a rabbit needs surgery for a hip injury

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The crash of a German plane flying over the French Alps, which inexplicably began losing altitude. The explanation for the disaster proves far more shocking than anyone expected

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The case of a plane that flew into a massive storm over Indonesia during the country's rainy season, but made a seemingly impossible emergency landing with only one casualty

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: The story of Air France Flight 447, a scheduled passenger flight from Rio de Janeiro to Paris which dramatically vanished over the Atlantic Ocean in June 2009

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend travel to Devon to fix up one of the fastest road cars of its time, a 1997 Mitsubishi Evo 4. In the 1990s, the Evos dominated the World Rally circuits and the two litre road going versions were no less impressive, making it one of the most extreme cars available for purchase. The car that Tim and Fuzz are taking on belongs to 60-year-old Gary, a petrolhead who loved his Evo and used it as his daily driver

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Two winter storms descend on North America, battering destination airports and leaving flights grounded at Pearson

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A Boeing 737 crashes just moments after lifting off from an Algerian desert airport. For investigators, it's clear the left engine exploded after liftoff, and that a fatigue crack eventually explains why. What's less obvious is why an experienced crew of the state-owned national carrier was unable to keep their plane in the sky

programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Hitler's downfall, a combined force of American and surrendered German soldiers must protect French prisoners of war from SS forces

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.sub-title: Bones Beneath and Coffins and Coins
programme.desc: Archaeologists uncover ancient tombs in Jordan and Peru, hidden treasure in Scotland and a Bronze Age coffin in England

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.sub-title: Perkin Warbeck & the Princes in the Tower
programme.desc: Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow investigate the man who claimed to be a missing prince and challenged Henry VII's rule

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: When a salmon truck crashes into a ditch, it kicks off a bad night for Thord. With truck drivers in trouble all over his territory, his team is pushed to the limit

programme.title: Nazi Megastructures: Battle Ready
programme.desc: Behind the Fuhrer was a small group of trusted generals. This is the story of Himmler, Goebbels and Goering

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Facing a cascade of failures and an engine fire, a turboprop is just seconds from the tarmac in Montreal when it flips over and crashes to the ground

programme.title: Nazi Megastructures
programme.desc: As the Nazi war machine reaches the English channel in 1940, Hitler forms a strategy to destroy Britain's air power and land troops in southern England

programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand
programme.desc: Wounded but unbroken, Captain Matt Urban returns to the front line and leads a fearless Sherman tank charge through Nazi defences

programme.title: Planes that Changed History

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.title: Inside Airport Lost & Found

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Chatroom Japan
programme.desc: A Chinese woman living in Japan holds gatherings for Chinese children with the goal of boosting their confidence in their international background.

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: Rising CO2 emissions are causing a phenomenon called ocean acidification, which severely impacts marine life and could further accelerate global warming. We examine its effects on the environment.

programme.title: DESIGN MUSEUM JAPAN
programme.desc: Ehime / Nagazumi Takashi (musician) Nagazumi visits a town with a great number of trowel reliefs, and observes that the things that truly last are the ones that carry the creator's intention.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: We explore a factory in Sagamihara where they make machines that skewer ingredients for famous Japanese foods like yakitori and oden. How do they ensure each piece is cooked to soft, juicy perfection?

programme.title: Time-lapse Japan
programme.desc: Hagi, a World Heritage site of ten described as an open-air museum, is lined with merchant and samurai houses and retains much of its 17th-century townscape. Soak in the atmosphere, in time-lapse.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: The Seasons of Yamato
programme.desc: A series of poetic videos by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara, in collaboration with a pianist, Mine Kawakami, for which she plays exclusive pieces, makes you experience each seasons.

programme.title: BOSAI:Science that Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Osaka, a city that thrives on rivers, has faced countless flood damage. Find out the latest measures protecting the city from typhoons and heavy rain.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history and culture. This episode looks at words related to theater. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: Easy Japanese
programme.desc: #38 I prefer outside. / To say which of 2 options you prefer, say the name of your choice, and no hoo ga ii desu.

programme.title: Culture Crossroads

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E5Exploring the machines that hide in the shadows, capturing, transmitting and analysing vital combat information.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E6In 1961, Soviet T-54 tanks and American M-48 Patton tanks face off at Checkpoint Charlie in Berlin.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7A look at the military engineering used as US and South Vietnamese forces attempt to overcome North Vietnam and the Viet Cong.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8A look at the origins of the Arms Race between the USA and the Soviet Union, and the nuclear weapons that ended WWII.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8In this episode we look at vessels built for amphibious combat. We begin by looking at the last reaming Landing Craft Tank (LCT) to serve on D-Day – LCT 7074. These huge landing craft were essential in delivering tanks, trucks, soldiers and supplies.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7A look at the military engineering used as US and South Vietnamese forces attempt to overcome North Vietnam and the Viet Cong.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E4We pinpoint the moment the USA became a global superpower when we recreate how the USS Olympia won the Battle of Manila Bay, and we show how the revolutionary British HMS Dreadnought brought ship design into the 20th century.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E1On September 1, 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland throws the world into war. No longer a European affair, the conflict spreads: in the Pacific, Japan—at war with China since 1937—accelerates its imperial ambitions.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E2In the East, Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and invades the Soviet Union, reaching the outskirts of Moscow. But winter and Soviet resistance break his momentum. The Red Army, boosted by relentless propaganda, put up a fierce fight.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E5A C-47 transport plane, with a crew of four, is ferrying 24 trainee P-47 fighter pilots from the Bruning Army Air Field in Nebraska to the South Dakotan Pierre Army Air Field for advanced training.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E4In the early hours of 8th July 1944, a normally quiet part of rural Northamptonshire was a hive of activity as the 17 twinned engine Wellington bombers rumbled down the runway of their Turweston airfield home.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E2Veterans and historians of the Thai-Burma railway tell the story of its construction. Built to supply Japan’s invasion of India, it cost thousands of lives – both POWs and Asian slave labourers.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E1Nazi Germany boasted that its locomotives were faster and more innovative. This programme examines that claim by looking at these ‘flying trains’.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E1Colditz Castle, the foreboding Nazi fortress that became a university of escapology; The Great Escape, and the doomed airmen of Stalag Luft Three; and the most daring breakout of them all, the ‘Warburg Wire Job’.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E2An adrenaline-fuelled dash through nazi-occupied Europe known as ‘The Flight of the Crow’, a death-defying escape across the world’s most perilous mountain range, and the largest escape of world war two - by men who chose death over dishonour.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E1February, 1943, a B-25 Mitchell Bomber crashes into Sharp Top Mountain. It was the third training crash in the area that night. What really caused this accident?

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E2A Liberator bomber from RAF Transport Command takes off from Gibraltar for England. On board is General Władysław Sikorski, Prime Minister of Poland's London-based government in exile and Commander-in-Chief of its armed forces.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E7Meanwhile in North Africa, the Italian dictator Mussolini had his own ideas about building a new Roman Empire in the region. And so he sent thousands of poorly-trained and ill-prepared Italian troops against the British garrison in Egypt.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E8This episode remembers some of the thunderous naval battles which took place during the Pacific war. They include the Battle of the Coral Sea, the battle of Midway and the biggest naval engagement of the war – the battle of Leyte Gulf.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E5Stunning, newly colorised combat and newsreel footage plus personal memoirs take us to the heart of a battle that would be a catastrophic blow to both sides and leave a muddy graveyard across East Belgium.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E6Rare newsreel and amateur footage, newly colorised, take us inside Hitler's crumbling empire and onto the front lines of the firefight for the streets of Berlin, a battle that will determine the fate of World War II.

programme.title: Hitler's British Island
programme.desc: E1On the orders of Adolf Hitler, the Nazi invaders of Alderney, a tiny island in the English Channel, shipped in more than 5,000 slave labourers to build an astonishing series of fortifications designed to protect the island from attack.

programme.title: Apocalypse D-Day
programme.desc: E1Spring 1944: The Allies aim to end Hitler's domination of Western Europe. In the south of England, troops are being trained in the greatest secrecy for a gigantic amphibious operation.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E1On September 1, 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland throws the world into war. No longer a European affair, the conflict spreads: in the Pacific, Japan—at war with China since 1937—accelerates its imperial ambitions.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E2In the East, Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and invades the Soviet Union, reaching the outskirts of Moscow. But winter and Soviet resistance break his momentum. The Red Army, boosted by relentless propaganda, put up a fierce fight.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5John F Kennedy first made news in 1943 when, as a skipper of a torpedo boat in the Pacific, he and his crew were shipwrecked. We tell the story of their rescue.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E3At Stalingrad, the German 6th Army is destroyed by the Soviets. It’s the first major defeat of the Third Reich, which marks the beginning of its decline. Elsewhere, after the American victory at Guadalcanal, Japan loses the initiative in the Pacific.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E4Operation Overlord is launched. With the Normandy Landings, the Allies pierce the Atlantic Wall. In the East, the Red Army sweeps through Belarus with Operation Bagration, annihilating the Wehrmacht. The end of the Third Reich is near.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E5A Greenpeace ship is bombed in 1985, killing Fernando Pereira. The French authorities deny responsibility and questions over nuclear restrictions arise again.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E6New weapons with devastating force shape the wars of the 20th century. International experts test the catastrophic effects of the three most destructive weapons of our time: the machine gun, hand grenade and tank.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E4In the 19th century, weapons became more sophisticated and more deadly, and the results were higher casualties with devastating wounds.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E3Four railway journeys that changed modern history: 24-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Hawker Hurricane was the first RAF aircraft to fly over 300mph. Over half of every enemy aeroplane destroyed in the Battle of Britain was by a Hurricane, not a Spitfire.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II. Regarded as one of the most important aircraft of the Cold War. It was a major part of the United States Air Force, Navy and Marine Corps, and was also used by many other countries.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E3The German mass breakout that stunned wartime Britain, the astonishing secret behind the daring escape of an American bomber crew trapped in the Soviet Union, and the Trojan Horse of Stalag Luft Three.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E4The Russian soldier who led a desperate outbreak from a secret Nazi death camp, Operation Chicken - an audacious plan to flee an escape-proof Japanese prison camp, and the pilots whose bold bid for freedom won the admiration of their enemies.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E7A look at key maritime weapons such as the secret super-weapon that kept Constantinople safe for centuries, the thunderous force of a ship's cannon, and the deadly torpedo.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E8Examining how the techniques of ambush, along with weapons that remained undetected until the very moment they were used, would revolutionise warfare.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E5The war enters its third year with battlefields in Eastern Europe, North Africa and the Asia/Pacific. The Battle of Midway, a battle with irreversible consequences, is a victory for the USA.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E5During the early months and years of the war, Britain and her allies were almost powerless to hit back at Germany. They were on the back foot, unable to take the war to where the Germans would feel it most – Germany.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E6The expansion of the Japanese empire had as its main aim the conquest of territories rich in natural resources. And so Japan cast its eyes towards South East Asia.

programme.title: Hitler's British Island
programme.desc: E2The killings carried out by the Nazis on Alderney during World War II represent the worst mass murder in British history, yet no one has been brought to justice.
